7708.title: Recurring automation retry consent has a pre-association race
7708.rootCauseOneLine: Consent lookup allows a missing run before spawn returns; the same early failure misses settlement, and service recovery can submit another automation run.
7708.proposedFix: Establish run/request ownership before first-turn lifecycle delivery, and prevent lost settlement during spawn.
7708.caveats: Forced SDK-boundary interleaving plus sweep-service restart; macOS wake, live Claude, durable retry dispatch, and three completed prompts are unverified. The runnable patch is embedded inline under repository publication policy.
